column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for each interaction record (e.g., 'ACT001').
A TIMESTAMP indicating when the interaction occurred.
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing Fans(UserRegistry), indicating which fan was involved.
A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing VirtualIdols(EntityReg), showing which idol was involved.
An enum (InteractionType_enum) describing the action (Vote, Comment, Share, Gift, Live Stream).
An enum (InteractionPlatform_enum) for the platform used (YouTube, Twitter, Official App, TikTok).
An enum (PlatformUsed_enum) describing the device platform (Tablet, Mobile, Console, PC).
An enum (DeviceType_enum) specifying the device type (Windows, iOS, Android, Mac).
A VARCHAR(20) capturing the version of the app used (e.g., 'v2.3.1').
An enum (GiftSendingFrequency_enum) capturing how often gifts are sent (Often, Rarely, Never, Frequent).
An INT total count of gifts sent during this session/interaction (e.g., 3).
A DECIMAL(10,2) total USD value of gifts (e.g., 15.50).
An enum (FavoriteGiftType_enum) for the fan’s preferred gift type (Limited, Custom, Premium, Standard).

JSONB column. Captures metrics related to fan engagement during interactions, such as session duration, live attendance, watch hours, and chat activity.
Fields: {"chat_activity":{"chatlang":"An enum (ChatLang_enum) describing chat language usage (Mixed, Translation, English, Native).","chatmsg":"An INT tally of messages sent in chat (e.g., 30).","emojicount":"An INT number of emoji used by the fan (e.g., 10).","msgtone":"An enum (MessageSentiment_enum) indicating the sentiment (Negative, Positive, Neutral).","stkcount":"An INT number of stickers used (e.g., 2)."},"session":{"liveatt":"A SMALLINT counting how many live stream attendances happened in this session.","sessdurmin":"A SMALLINT measuring session duration in minutes (e.g., 45).","watchhrs":"A DECIMAL(6,1) specifying how many hours of content the fan watched (e.g., 2.5)."}}
